title: kymo stats --json
description: Statistics of a range of a capture. Durations and instants are in cycles of the trace's cycle counter; seconds are since the first event, at the frequency given, null without one.

frequency.description: The frequency of the seconds, in hertz.

from.description: The range's start, within the trace's events.

to.description: The range's end, within the trace's events.

origin.description: The cycles of the first event, where the seconds start.

known.description: The range less what its losses hid.

suspects.description: The writers reported overrun in the range.

detail.description: What divides the metric further: a wake reason, a task; null for its total.

excluded_loss.description: The instances that touch a loss.

excluded_suspect.description: The instances that cover an overrun write.

cut.description: The instances cut by the range, or open at the end.

lower_bound.description: Whether instances were excluded: the max and the high percentiles are then a lower bound.

share.description: The total over the time known, for a net execution.

p50.description: The value of rank ceil(0.5 n) among the sorted values.

first.description: The first bin's lower bound, a multiple of the width.

worst.description: The highest values, the earliest first among equals.

point.description: A value, and where its instance starts.

index.description: The index of the instance's first event.
